items.title: Braelon Allen: Cedes majority of work to Hall
items.text:
Allen rushed eight times for 33 yards, caught both of his targets for 21 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Out for remainder of Sunday's game
items.text:
Stevenson (knee) won't return to Sunday's game against the Packers, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tetairoa McMillan: Salvages day with late TD
items.text:
McMillan caught four of six targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chuba Hubbard: Comes up short of 100 scrimmage yards
items.text:
Hubbard carried the ball 16 times for 79 yards and caught four of five targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 26-21 loss to Denver.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Heads to locker room Sunday
items.text:
Stevenson headed to the locker room during Sunday's game against the Packers to be evaluated for an unspecified issue, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bryce Young: Three TDs not enough Sunday
items.text:
Young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos. He added 13 yards on his only carry and lost a fumble.
